scripts.name: validate-storage
scripts.description: Comprehensive validation tool for the storage system. Checks schema validation, referential integrity, file existence, orphan detection, ID format, date format, required fields, duplicates, version validation, and length limits across all three subsections.

scripts.name: test-edge-cases
scripts.description: Edge case and boundary testing suite for the storage system. Runs 35 tests covering malformed JSON, long descriptions, special characters, ID format violations, category mismatches, version field issues, and duplicate detection.

scripts.name: repair-storage
scripts.description: Automated repair tool for common storage system issues. Fixes versions, dates, rebuilds category indexes, removes duplicates, truncates long descriptions, and ensures structural completeness. Supports --dry-run mode.

scripts.name: grade-research
scripts.description: Evaluates research JSON quality across five dimensions: citation count/quality, coverage breadth, depth (word count), and specificity (metrics, tools, code). Outputs a graded report with recommendations.

scripts.name: merge-research
scripts.description: Merges multiple team research JSON files by topic category. Deduplicates techniques using string similarity, identifies coverage gaps across teams, and outputs a unified research document.

scripts.name: data-gathering-websearch
scripts.description: Multi-query web search via DuckDuckGo. Generates 3-5 query variants and deduplicates results by URL.

scripts.name: data-gathering-wikipedia
scripts.description: Wikipedia API deep extraction with DuckDuckGo fallback. Extracts summaries, sections, references, categories, and follows See Also links.

scripts.name: data-gathering-arxiv
scripts.description: arXiv academic paper search with DuckDuckGo fallback. Extracts titles, authors, abstracts, categories, and publication dates.

scripts.name: data-gathering-hybrid
scripts.description: Hybrid multi-source aggregation combining web search, Wikipedia, and arXiv. Cross-references findings and scores by corroboration count.

scripts.name: data-gathering-iterative
scripts.description: Iterative deepening search doing 3 rounds of progressively deeper DuckDuckGo queries. Each round refines queries based on previous results.

scripts.name: data-gathering-benchmark
scripts.description: Benchmark harness that runs all data gathering methods against a test query, times them, and calculates quality scores based on result count, source diversity, and information density.

scripts.name: kb-validator
scripts.description: Validates knowledge base entries and index.json consistency. Checks YAML frontmatter required fields, builds_on references, index entry/file matching, tag_index completeness, category consistency, and team ID format. Outputs structured JSON report.

scripts.name: index-rebuilder
scripts.description: Auto-generates index.json files by scanning knowledge-base/entries/ and teams/sessions/ directories. Parses YAML frontmatter, rebuilds entries, categories, and tag_index. Supports --dry-run and --fix modes with diff output.

scripts.name: cross-ref-checker
scripts.description: Validates all cross-references across the repository. Checks KB builds_on chains, team session KB references, script dependencies. Detects cycles via DFS, finds orphan files and dangling index entries. Outputs dependency tree and structured JSON report.

scripts.name: fast-search
scripts.description: High-speed full-text search index compiled in Go. Builds an inverted index of all .md, .json, .py, .go files. Supports exact match, multi-word AND, and phrase search modes. Query time <5ms on current corpus (126 files). Outputs JSON results with file, line, column, and context.

scripts.name: fast-validate
scripts.description: High-speed repository structure validator compiled in Go. Validates all index.json files, cross-references (KB builds_on, script dependencies), file existence, orphan detection, and dependency cycle detection in a single pass. Completes in <2ms. Outputs JSON report with pass/fail and all issues.

scripts.name: fast-cache
scripts.description: High-speed file-based key-value cache for API responses, compiled in Go. Keys are SHA-256 of URL. Supports get, set (with TTL), delete, stats, gc (garbage collection), and keys commands. Uses index file + data directory for sub-millisecond cache hits. CLI interface with JSON output.

scripts.name: kb-search
scripts.description: Full-text search across KB entries, team logs, and script metadata using TF-IDF ranking. CLI with argparse supporting query, --tags, --category, and --type filters. Returns ranked results with context snippets.

scripts.name: handoff-tracker
scripts.description: Parses Handoff Notes sections from team session logs, extracts action items, and checks if subsequent teams addressed each item. Tracks resolution rate across all iterations.

scripts.name: staleness-detector
scripts.description: Repository health checker with 6 checks: stale statuses, regressions, unaddressed handoffs, broken references, index mismatches, and orphan files. Outputs scored health report.

scripts.name: ddg-utils
scripts.description: Shared DuckDuckGo search utilities. Contains DuckDuckGoParser class, search_duckduckgo function, rate limiting (0.5s between requests), and configurable User-Agent. Extracted from 4 duplicate implementations.

scripts.name: request-cache
scripts.description: File-based HTTP response cache with SHA-256 keys, base64 storage, and configurable TTL (default 1 hour). Functions: cached_request(), clear_cache(), cache_stats().

scripts.name: data-gathering-openalex
scripts.description: OpenAlex academic search via REST API. Searches 250M+ scholarly works, extracts titles, authors, abstracts (from inverted index), citation counts, DOIs, and open access status. Uses polite pool for higher rate limits.

scripts.name: data-gathering-hackernews
scripts.description: Hacker News search via Algolia API plus Firebase top stories. Extracts titles, URLs, authors, points, comment counts. Deduplicates across both sources.

scripts.name: data-gathering-guardian
scripts.description: Guardian news search via Open Platform API. Extracts headlines, body text, sections, and publication dates. Falls back to DuckDuckGo site-scoped search if API fails.

scripts.name: data-gathering-semantic-scholar
scripts.description: Semantic Scholar paper search via Academic Graph API. Extracts titles, authors, abstracts, AI-generated TLDRs, citation counts, fields of study, and open access PDF links. Respects 1 req/sec rate limit.

scripts.name: data-gathering-wikidata
scripts.description: Wikidata knowledge graph search. Two-phase: searches entities then fetches full details including labels, descriptions, key properties (instance of, subclass of), and Wikipedia sitelinks.

scripts.name: data-gathering-github
scripts.description: GitHub repository and code search via REST API. Searches repos by stars, extracts descriptions, languages, topics, licenses, and fork counts. Also searches code with graceful rate-limit handling.

scripts.name: bus-cli
scripts.description: CLI for JSONL message bus operations. Provides command-line interface for reading, writing, and managing messages on the JSONL-based inter-agent communication bus.

scripts.name: multi-team-runner
scripts.description: Production multi-team launcher with heartbeat monitoring. Manages lifecycle of multiple agent teams with health checks, restart logic, and coordinated startup/shutdown.

scripts.name: think-tank
scripts.description: Convergence script for cross-referencing team findings. Aggregates and reconciles results from multiple teams to identify consensus, conflicts, and coverage gaps.

scripts.name: dashboard
scripts.description: Real-time text-based agent monitoring dashboard. Displays live status of running agent teams, message throughput, task progress, and system health in a terminal UI.

scripts.name: coordinator-hub
scripts.description: Hub-and-spoke agent coordination via SQLite. Central coordinator that manages task assignment, result collection, and agent communication through a SQLite-based shared state.

scripts.name: build-cross-ref-index
scripts.description: Cross-reference index builder. Scans repository to build a comprehensive index of all cross-references between KB entries, team logs, scripts, and other artifacts.

scripts.name: search-storage
scripts.description: Storage search utility. Provides search capabilities across the storage system including scripts, API tools, and data sources.

scripts.name: stress-test-setup-reads
scripts.description: Read stress test setup. Prepares the environment and test data for storage system read stress testing.

scripts.name: stress-test-reads-category
scripts.description: Category read stress testing. Stress tests the storage system's category-based read operations under high load conditions.

scripts.name: stress-test-reads-cross
scripts.description: Cross-reference read stress testing. Stress tests the storage system's cross-reference lookup operations under high load conditions.

scripts.name: stress-test-reads-id
scripts.description: ID lookup read stress testing. Stress tests the storage system's ID-based lookup operations under high load conditions.

scripts.name: stress-test-writes
scripts.description: Write stress testing. Stress tests the storage system's write operations including concurrent writes, large payloads, and rapid sequential writes.

scripts.name: test-utilities
scripts.description: Test suite for data-gathering utility modules (ddg_utils, request_cache, dedup_utils). Covers rate limiter thread safety, config locks, cache operations, TOCTOU-safe reads, tokenization, similarity scoring, and deduplication.

scripts.name: test-cross-references
scripts.description: Cross-reference analysis test script. Populates index.json files with test entries and validates cross-referencing capabilities across scripts, API tools, and sources indexes.
